create_spline_from_points: create a Spline object from a numpy array of 2D or 3D points with optional closed loop
interpolate_spline_at_distance: interpolate the Spline at a given arc length distance to get coordinates along the curve
add_custom_track_to_spline: add a custom data track to the Spline with linear or circular interpolation mode
reparameterize_spline_uniformly: reparameterize the Spline to have equal-length segments with configurable smoothing factor
compute_angle_difference: compute the signed angle difference between two sets of cosine and sine angle pairs
